headline: Beijing issues new commercial housing sales rules, prioritizing ready-built home sales
summary: Beijing has issued new commercial housing sales rules that prioritise the sale of ready-built homes. The rules also cover presales, land supply and sales policy in the municipality.
why: China's property sector is a large part of its economy, and changes to sales rules affect developers' cash flow and homebuyer demand.
